instruction: Move all products with under 4.2 rating from my amazon cart to wish list.
notes: The cart contents and product ratings are world facts the agent discovers at runtime: show_cart makes product ids known (cart-listed), show_product reveals each product's rating (rating-known), and only products with rating under 4.2 (static fact rating-under-threshold) may be moved. product-a / product-b are placeholders for the two classes of cart products (under 4.2 vs not); at runtime the move action is repeated for every product in the first class and show_product for every cart product. move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list is called without quantity so the full cart quantity is moved, matching the expected cart/wish-list quantity maps. Because the goal conditions are per-product and quantified goals are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task only requires (cart-listed); it is still forced to be last since every other action requires (not (task-completed)) and the goal demands the per-product conditions together with (task-completed). No answer is passed to complete_task.
